sentence.en: Every page, block, and link is a node in one graph — and the operation log is the only authority.

set.name: Margin Green
set.mechanism: The page is the canvas and the margin is where thought accumulates: one permanent rule in ink is the coordinate, and small green annotations appear where something new lands — Newsreader for the words, Instrument Sans for the chrome, warm paper for both. The margin is permanent; the green mark is the act of adding.
set.expression_move: The green annotation tick is transient — it appears where thought lands; the margin never moves.
set.differs_by: The measured shelf is cool or achromatic tools; nobody owns an editorial margin system where permanent structure and the act of adding are two colours.

logo.concept: The margin rule with three annotations: a coordinate, not a container — the place where the reading and the thinking happen.

misuse.label: Annotations live in the margin — never off the page
The margin is vertical — never lay the rule down as a divider

defaults_used.why: The warm-paper ground is the product's existing equity (#f5f3ef in variables.css); the margin device and the green annotation, not the ground, carry the distinction.

rationale.claim: The measured competitor shelf is cool or achromatic; nobody owns warm paper with an editorial annotation voice.
Advance Green is measured outside every AI-default colour region and carries the arrival semantics from the Record direction: green marks what just landed, ink is permanent.
Newsreader carries long-form reading at text sizes with tabular figures; Instrument Sans keeps the chrome contemporary — the editorial-software hybrid the brief asks for.
Owner synthesis 2026-10-07: margin = structure, green = the act of adding; two colours, one permanent and one transient.
